metadata.description: Grok Build plugins that passed a kintsugi assay: pinned to one commit, installed clean, read for what they execute, with every crack and seal published.

plugins.name: api-documentation
plugins.description: API documentation: docs-site architecture, OpenAPI reference generation and linting, operation-level writing, error catalogs, and SDK guides.

plugins.name: chrome-devtools
plugins.description: Chrome DevTools skills for driving and debugging a live Chrome (performance traces, network, console, accessibility, memory). Register the pinned MCP server with grok mcp add; see the entry card.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare developer platform skills (Workers, Durable Objects, Agents SDK, Wrangler, Sandbox, Turnstile, Cloudflare One) and the hosted Cloudflare MCP server.

plugins.name: communication-buses
plugins.description: I2C, SPI, UART, CAN and USB drivers with DMA strategy, error recovery, bit timing math and MCU peripheral quirks.

plugins.name: compound-engineering
plugins.description: Every's 36-skill loop for brainstorming, planning, building, reviewing and recording what each change taught.

plugins.name: datadog
plugins.description: Datadog's hosted MCP server for logs, metrics, traces, monitors and dashboards, with a connection-troubleshooting skill and a Datadog App scaffolder.

plugins.name: design-mastery
plugins.description: Design principles, legendary designers and design movements applied to UI work, with design audits, brand identity, style guides and premium landing pages.

plugins.name: domain-driven-design
plugins.description: Domain-Driven Design: bounded contexts, context maps, aggregates, value objects, domain events and event storming.

plugins.name: feature-dev
plugins.description: Guided feature development in seven phases, with codebase explorer, architect and reviewer agents.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: A skill for distinctive, intentional frontend design: a subject-grounded design plan, a review against the brief, then the build.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a HANDOFF.md at session end that captures state, diff-invisible context, verify commands, and one specific next step, indexed for /pickup.

plugins.name: kubernetes-operations
plugins.description: Design, deploy and troubleshoot production Kubernetes workloads, from resources, probes, RBAC and NetworkPolicies to autoscaling, Helm and common pod failures.

plugins.name: ledger-design
plugins.description: Double-entry ledger design: account taxonomy, immutable journal events, balance invariants, materialized balances, compensating corrections, multi-currency and rounding, and reconciliation.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills: grilling, specs and tickets, TDD, bug diagnosis, code review, deep-module design, handoffs.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Current web platform guidance and Chrome extension skills from the Google Chrome team, with 162 bundled guides.

plugins.name: mongodb
plugins.description: MongoDB's skills for read-only queries, schema design, query and index optimization, Atlas Search and Vector Search, connection tuning and stream processing, with the self-managed MongoDB MCP server run through npx.

plugins.name: multiplayer-networking
plugins.description: Multiplayer netcode: rollback, lockstep, client prediction with reconciliation, lag compensation, bandwidth budgets, NAT traversal, and Godot or Unity networking.

plugins.name: netlify-skills
plugins.description: Netlify reference skills for Functions, Edge Functions, Blobs, the managed database, Identity, Forms, caching, AI Gateway, framework adapters and deploys, plus Netlify's hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Six skills that steer the agent to the smallest change that works: YAGNI, stdlib and platform first, and reviews that list what to delete.

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Six focused review agents (comments, tests, silent failures, types, code, simplification) and a /review-pr command.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: Engineering playbooks (poteto-mode) and principle skills for rigorous, verifiable agent work. The Cursor-specific model routing needs the workarounds in the entry card.

plugins.name: rag-architecture
plugins.description: Retrieval-augmented generation: chunking, embeddings, vector stores, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounded generation, and evaluation.

plugins.name: railway
plugins.description: Railway's use-railway skill and hosted MCP server for projects, services, databases, deploys, variables, logs and metrics, with the skill-scope and hook workarounds in the entry card.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Sentry's skills for SDK setup, issue debugging, readable stack traces, releases, alerts and OpenTelemetry, with Sentry's hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: sprites
plugins.description: Fly.io Sprites for Grok Build: isolated, checkpointable remote Linux sandboxes through the hosted Sprites MCP server with OAuth, and skills for exec, services, checkpoints and network policy.

plugins.name: supabase
plugins.description: Supabase's skills for every Supabase product and for Postgres schema, index and RLS rules, with Supabase's hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Skills for disciplined engineering: brainstorming before code, written plans, test-driven development, systematic debugging, code review and verification before completion.
